name: emcc
description: EMCC (Every Mod Claude Code): a curated, tested collection of Claude Code mods.

plugins.name: emcc-core
plugins.description: EMCC's shared base: the $.emcc noun (evidence, badges, profile, kill switch) and one status band above the prompt.

plugins.name: goalpost-guard
plugins.description: Stops Claude from passing a check by lowering the bar: weakened or deleted tests, new suppressions, relaxed config, softened CI, lowered coverage, skipped git hooks.
